title: Simple Way to Make Homemade Cloth Masks: Fabrics Treated with NaCl and Starch Solution
author: M Mehedi Hasan Rocky
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.be9djh26

steps.title: Prepare the cloth sheet
steps.instruction: Cut a rectangular piece of cotton/linen woven cloth or napkin fabric and finish the edges.

substeps.instruction: Cut cloth to a width of 18 to 21 inches and a length of 30 to 40 inches.
Fold over all sides by 1/4 inch and stitch down.

steps.title: Clean the cloth
steps.instruction: Clean the cloth sheet for the mask using a normal detergent or soap.

steps.title: Prepare salt-starching solution
steps.instruction: Create a treatment solution using liquid starch, salt, and hot water.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve 1/2 cup liquid starch (homemade or laundry) and 1 spoon table salt (NaCl) in 1.5 to 2 liters of hot water.
Optional: Add 1 or 2 drops of essential oil for fragrance.

steps.title: Treat and dry the cloth
steps.instruction: Apply the salt-starch solution to the cloth and dry it.

substeps.instruction: Soak the cloth sheet properly in a bowl containing the hot salt-starch solution (note: one batch of solution treats 4 to 5 sheets).
Press out all unabsorbed solution from the cloth sheet.
Hang the cloth outside under the sun to dry (do not perform salt-starching on rainy days).

steps.title: Fold and iron the fabric
steps.instruction: Fold the treated cloth to create a multi-layered mask structure.

substeps.instruction: Fold the cloth to make three layers with a width of 5-7 inches (depending on face shape) to cover from the nose to the lower chin.
For cloth with fewer fibers, increase the number of layers by adjusting the width before cutting the sheet.
Identify the mid-section ('b') and the two end-sections ('a' and 'c').

steps.title: Wear the mask
steps.instruction: Position the mask on the face and secure it at the back of the head.

substeps.instruction: Place the mid-section ('b') to cover the nose, mouth, and lower chin.
Wrap end-sections ('a' and 'c') around the back of the head.
Hold moderately tight and tie a knot, or use buttons as an alternative to the knot.

steps.title: Sterilize and reactivate
steps.instruction: Clean the mask for reuse or restore the starch treatment.

substeps.instruction: Place the mask in boiling water for 10 minutes to sterilize and reduce starch content.
Reuse after drying, or reactivate the treatment by repeating the cleaning, starching, and folding steps.
